baseUrl.description: DSO-LV outbound (voortgangsinformatie/besluit) endpoint base URL (no trailing slash)

mode.description: `token` (default) sends a Bearer Authorization header from `encryptedToken`. `mtls` dispatches over a real PKIoverheid mutual-TLS connection using `mtls.*` — closes the real DSO-LV outbound transport gap.

encryptedToken.description: Required when `mode=token` (the default). The DSO-LV API token, encrypted at rest via OCP\Security\ICrypto — never store the raw token.

scheme.description: Authorization header scheme, used only when `mode=token`.

mtls.description: Required when `mode=mtls`. Client certificate material, each field individually encrypted at rest via OCP\Security\ICrypto.

encryptedCaBundle.description: Optional PEM CA bundle to verify the peer against.

bronorganisatie.description: This bevoegd gezag's OIN/bronorganisatie code (outbound stuurgegevens default).

maxFileSize.description: Largest bijlage download in bytes. Larger bijlagen are not stored. Default 104857600 (100 MB).
